theorem algebra_sum1onsqrt2to1onsqrt10000lt198 :
    (∑ k in Finset.Icc (2 : ℕ) 10000, 1 / Real.sqrt k) < 198 := by


  have h : ∀ k : ℕ, k ∈ Finset.Icc (2 : ℕ) 10000 → (1 : ℕ) / Real.sqrt k ≤ 1 := by
    intro k hk
    have h₁ : k ≥ 2 := by
      simp [Finset.mem_Icc] at hk
      linarith
    have h₂ : Real.sqrt k ≥ 1 := by
      have h₃ : (k : ℝ) ≥ 2 := by exact_mod_cast h₁
      have h₄ : Real.sqrt k ≥ 1 := by
        apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
        linarith
      exact h₄
    have h₅ : (1 : ℕ) / Real.sqrt k ≤ 1 := by
      have h₆ : (1 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt k ≤ 1 := by
        have h₇ : Real.sqrt k ≥ 1 := by exact h₂
        have h₈ : (1 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt k ≤ 1 := by
          rw [div_le_iff (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith))]
          nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg k, Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ))]
        exact h₈
      have h₇ : (1 : ℕ) / Real.sqrt k ≤ 1 := by
        have h₈ : (1 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt k ≤ 1 := by exact h₆
        have h₉ : (1 : ℕ) / Real.sqrt k ≤ 1 := by
          apply Nat.div_le_self
        exact h₉
      exact h₇
    exact h₅
  have h₂ : (∑ k in Finset.Icc (2 : ℕ) 10000, 1 / Real.sqrt k) ≤ (∑ k in Finset.Icc (2 : ℕ) 10000, 1 : ℝ) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro k hk
    have h₃ : k ∈ Finset.Icc (2 : ℕ) 10000 := by exact hk
    have h₄ : (1 : ℕ) / Real.sqrt k ≤ 1 := by
      exact h k h₃

          simp [Finset.mem_Icc] at h₃
          linarith
        have h₈ : (k : ℝ) ≥ 2 := by exact_mod_cast h₇
        have h₉ : Real.sqrt k ≥ 1 := by
          apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
          linarith
        exact h₉
      have h₇ : (1 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt k ≤ 1 := by
        rw [div_le_iff (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith))]
        nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg k, Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ))]
      exact h₇
    exact h₅
  have h₃ : (∑ k in Finset.Icc (2 : ℕ) 10000, 1 : ℝ) = 9999 := by
    rfl
  have h₄ : (∑ k in Finset.Icc (2 : ℕ) 10000, 1 / Real.sqrt k) ≤ 9999 := by
    linarith
  have h₅ : (∑ k in Finset.Icc (2 : ℕ) 10000, 1 / Real.sqrt k) < 198 := by

    <;> linarith
  exact h₅
